description:
**CVRP seeded generalized assignment followed by route optimization.** Use a complete distance matrix, indexed nonnegative demands, capacity and fixed customer seeds on at most 11 customers. Stage one minimizes a single-insertion cost surrogate while assigning customers to capacitated seed groups.

Pass the entire group to exact path ordering with the depot as both endpoints when it has at most eight customers. A larger group retains its constructed order. A seeded assignment failure leads to a feasible savings construction.

The exposed seeds fix the route slots in the first stage. Assignment cost is a surrogate for future routing decisions. The combination implements the assignment-then-route structure using small standard-library subproblems.
